lon 44 12, spoke ship Sea King, from Liverpool for St John,

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 23 May 1866, p. 4, col. 5

claims.verbatim:
Ship Constitution, Mitchell, Liverpool 28[?] days, with mdse. and 410
pass. to Williams & Guion. On 4th inst., in lat. 45 50, long. 44 12,
spoke ship Sea King, from Liverpool for St. John's, N. B.; 11th, in lat.
43, long. 63[?] 52, passed bark Glenalladale (of Pictou), bound W; same
day, James Neagle[?] and Martin Power, seamen, while reefing foresail,
in a SW gale, fell overboard, and were lost; 1 pass. died.
